name: schengen-visa-guide
title_zh: 申根签材料清单，按身份拆到每张纸
tagline_zh: 学生、退休、自由职业、无业、未成年……每种身份该交什么、不该交什么，一次说清。照着备，别让签证官挑出毛病。
tagline_en: Student, retired, freelancer, unemployed, minor—exactly what to prepare and what to skip. Get your documents.
desc_en: Use EXCLUSIVELY when user mentions Schengen visa (申根签/申根签证/办申根签) or wants to apply for a tourist visa to Schengen countries (France, Italy, Spain, Germany, Switzerland, etc.). Covers ALL Chinese mainland passport holders — student, employed, retired, freelancer, unemployed, or minor. This skill ONLY covers Schengen short-stay tourist visas.
why_zh: 不是泛泛而谈的攻略，而是按中国大陆护照持有者的六种身份逐一拆解，连材料细节和常见坑都标出来。
why_en: Not generic advice—it breaks down requirements for six applicant types under Chinese passport, flagging pitfalls and specifics.
limit_zh: 只覆盖申根短期旅游签，不涉及商务、探亲、留学等类型；仅针对中国大陆护照，其他护照持有者不适用。
limit_en: Short-stay tourist visa only; excludes business, family visit, study. For mainland China passport holders only.
title_en: Schengen Visa Checklist by Applicant Type
